title: Rishabh Pant Hits Fastest 100 Sixes in Test Cricket History
summary: Indian cricketer Rishabh Pant has achieved a significant milestone by completing his 100th six in Test cricket. He reached this feat during the Galle Test against Sri Lanka. Pant became the fastest batsman globally to hit 100 Test sixes, surpassing the previous record held by Adam Gilchrist.
summary_points: Rishabh Pant completed his 100th six in Test cricket.
The milestone was achieved during the Galle Test against Sri Lanka.
Pant is now the fastest batsman in the world to reach 100 Test sixes.
He broke the previous record held by Adam Gilchrist.

summary_hi: भारतीय क्रिकेटर ऋषभ पंत ने टेस्ट क्रिकेट में अपने 100वें छक्के के साथ एक महत्वपूर्ण उपलब्धि हासिल की है। उन्होंने श्रीलंका के खिलाफ गॉल टेस्ट के दौरान यह मुकाम हासिल किया। पंत दुनिया के सबसे तेज बल्लेबाज बन गए हैं जिन्होंने 100 टेस्ट छक्के लगाए, उन्होंने एडम गिलक्रिस्ट का पिछला रिकॉर्ड तोड़ा।
